blocks.value: The doctoral programme in Environmental Science trains researchers to investigate environmental systems and produce original scholarly work. Study proceeds in four stages: coursework, candidacy, independent research, and a dissertation defended before an examining committee.

Granite Hill School 
of Advanced Research
Design and carry out independent research on a significant environmental science problem.
Apply advanced theory, field, laboratory, and quantitative methods appropriate to the dissertation.
Produce an original contribution to knowledge in environmental science, suitable for scholarly publication.
Evaluate environmental evidence, uncertainty, and the implications of research for policy and practice.
On completion of the programme, the candidate will be able to:
Written examinations, research papers, laboratory/field reports, and seminar
Closed written papers plus an oral examination before a faculty committee.
Written research proposal and oral defense.
Original monograph (or equivalent paper-based thesis) assessed by internal and
